summary: Iteration 16 - Regression verification after hook-dependency + list-key cleanup on Dashboard, HaanaAssistant, ShopSale. Both backend and frontend green. Explicitly verified NO render loop on Dashboard: idle /api/stats/overview delta = 0 over 3s wait; each filter change triggers exactly 1 call. No duplicate-key warnings, no console errors, no pageerrors across the entire regression sweep.

dashboard_render_loop_check.verdict: PASS - no infinite loop, effect fires once per filter change as intended

list_keys_check.verdict: PASS - stable composite keys render correctly

haana_check.verdict: PASS - message ids and chip text keys work; single LLM call as requested

shop_sale_check.verdict: PASS - refreshTotals runs once on mount, no repeated polling

regression_smoke.stock: loaded (page rendered; st-grid selector not present but page shell fine)

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx line 98: useEffect depends on both `f` and `load`; load is stable (empty-deps useCallback) so effect fires only when f changes. Passing f directly to load(f) is correct - the fRef is a safety net for load() called without args (refresh/seed). Clean.
Dashboard.jsx `seed()` calls `load()` without args and relies on fRef.current - works but could be `load(f)` for clarity/consistency.

HaanaAssistant.jsx: nextId ref counter is fine, but note that history fetch (line 33) synthesises ids as `h${i}` while live messages use `u${n}`/`a${n}` - no collision risk today but keep the two id namespaces distinct if the hydration ever mixes.

ShopSale.jsx refreshTotals fetches the entire sheet (api.lineRows) just to compute 3 counters - not new to this iteration but worth noting: consider a lightweight /stats/shop-sale endpoint if the sheet grows.
seed_data_creation: None - read-only regression run. No writes to any sheet.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard uses useCallback(load, []) + fRef pattern; effect deps are [f, load]. To detect render loops, count /api/stats/overview requests during a 3s idle window - should be 0. HaanaAssistant now keys messages by internal id (u#/a#/h#) and chips by chip text. ShopSale refreshTotals is useCallback([]) with effect deps [refreshTotals] - single call on mount, and one call after each onSaved from LineSheet.
